items.difficulty_reason: 38 行：一向由「拉回保持伪凝聚」直接给出；另一向先把 fppf 覆盖化到「仿射底 + 单个有限展示的平坦满射」（取有限个仿射开覆盖底开集），再对界 m 归纳——顶部上同调在拉回后有限型，**有限型沿平坦满射下降**得到底上的有限型模与到该上同调的满射，提升为映射后作 distinguished triangle，用锥把度数降低、由归纳假设收尾。承重步骤（归约、下降、锥）都在 span 内；4 处引用全跨章，作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-pseudo-coherent-descends-fppf (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 3070-3076

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the reduction to the affine case and to a single surjective flat morphism of finite presentation, the induction on the top degree using the finite type descent statement, and the cone argument that lowers the degree (source lines 3078-3115)
